title: Create your first invoice
subtitle: Acme Billing in under two minutes

intro.say: In this short tutorial, you'll create and save your first invoice in Acme Billing.

steps.say: Start on the sign in page and enter your work email.
Your invoices are listed here. To make a new one, click New invoice.
And enter the price. The total updates as you type.
Check the total, then save the invoice.
Your new invoice now sits at the bottom of the list, marked as a draft.
And the outstanding amount already includes it.

outro.say: That's it. You've created your first invoice.
outro.title: You're all set!
outro.text: Next up: sending an invoice to your customer
